30

Problem Statement
Write a program to create a Student class and display student information using objects.
Description
Create a class named Student with the following attributes:
Student ID
Student Name
Marks
Read the values from the user and perform the following operations:
Display the Student ID.
Display the Student Name.
Display the Marks.
Display the Grade based on marks:
Marks ≥ 90 → Grade A
Marks ≥ 75 → Grade B
Marks ≥ 50 → Grade C
Otherwise → Grade D

101
John
85
